title: In the Dark Circus Arts
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: In the Dark Circus Arts is Baltimore’s home for all things circus! We love to teach people of all ages, abilities, and experiences something new. Circus provides everyone with a unique way to strengthen our bodies, express ourselves creatively, and honestly show off your really cool skills to your friends and family! Our coaches are the best in the Baltimore area.
